articles.title: Travis Kelce has a sweet response to Taylor Swift's viral outburst at Arrowhead: “I had to make her proud”
articles.standfirst: Kelce exploded for over 100 yards against the Indianapolis Colts on Sunday Night Football.
articles.summary: Kelce exploded for over 100 yards against the Indianapolis Colts on Sunday Night Football.
articles.body:
Taylor Swift ’s celebration after Travis Kelce ’s touchdown quickly became one of the defining moments of the Kansas City Chiefs ’ win and now, the NFL star has revealed what he made of his wife’s viral reaction. Swift made her feelings known at Arrowhead Stadium after the 36-year-old tight end found the end zone, as the cameras spied her pointing to her wedding ring and declaring, “That’s my husband!”

The clip quickly went viral across the internet, and the three-time Super Bowl champion addressed it alongside his older brother, Jason , during Wednesday’s episode of their New Heights podcast. “Just doing my deed as a husband,” Travis coolly quipped on September 23 . “Listen man, proud wife, baby. Gotta make my girl proud.” His touchdown was part of a standout night against the Indianapolis Colts , as the Chiefs escaped with a dramatic 33-30 overtime victory to improve to 2-0 for the 2025 NFL season. The score came during a game in which Kelce looked particularly sharp, helping Patrick Mahomes and the Chiefs overcome a back-and-forth contest that ultimately went down to the final kick.

Kelce reacts to historic achievement against Colts

Kelce finished with nine catches for 101 yards and that touchdown for one of his best games in recent years, and one that gave him another milestone to celebrate after an eventful night in Kansas City . The veteran also set an NFL record for career receiving yards after the catch, surpassing Marshall Faulk with 6,288 yards after the catch to become the outright leader of any position – including wide receiver. “This is by far the craziest thing and honestly one of the coolest accomplishments I’ve ever had,” Travis continued. “I had no idea I was even in the ballpark. I didn’t know I was Top 5, Top 10, ever. I would have guessed there was so many more. “You don’t get this kind of stuff without having the guys around you to help you get these yards, but at the same time, man, it’s a pretty cool stat to be a part of. “When I’ve got the ball in my hands, I’m doing the most I can with it. It’s proven throughout the history of the NFL that I’ve been pretty good at it.” After Indianapolis and Kansas City traded field goals in overtime, Mahomes connected with Kenneth Walker for a 22-yard completion that put Harrison Butker in position to kick the winning 40-yard field goal. Mahomes threw for 382 yards and three touchdowns, while Walker rushed for 117 yards. Butker then delivered the decisive moment, and critics now wonder if the Chiefs are truly back after finishing with a 6-11 record in 2025.

articles.title: Mahomes' New Weapon: Why Chiefs offense looks unstoppable heading into matchup against the Dolphins
articles.standfirst: The Chiefs’ new backfield threat is creating better conditions for Mahomes and the passing game
articles.summary: The Chiefs’ new backfield threat is creating better conditions for Mahomes and the passing game
articles.body:
Kansas City’s offense has spent years forcing defenses to choose between bad options, but Kenneth Walker III may have added another one.

The Chiefs enter Sunday’s game against the Miami Dolphins at 2-0, and their early-season attack already looks more varied than it did a year ago.

Patrick Mahomes is still the centerpiece, but Walker ’s production through two games has made it much harder for opponents to devote all their attention to the passing game.

Walker has carried 47 times for 290 yards while adding nine receptions, giving Kansas City a runner capable of setting the tempo rather than simply complementing it.

That matters because Miami now has to decide how aggressively it wants to defend the box.

Walker gives Kansas City true early-down weapon

Locked On Chiefs host Chris Clark believes the run game should be central to Kansas City’s plan, with Walker potentially seeing around 20 carries if the game develops that way.

The logic is straightforward. If Miami commits heavier personnel to slowing Walker , Mahomes gets cleaner opportunities against the secondary. If the Dolphins stay light, Walker has already shown he can punish poor tackling and create explosive gains.

Miami has used heavier fronts and base personnel to defend the run, according to Locked On Dolphins host Kyle Crabbs , but that approach creates its own risks against Mahomes and Travis Kelce .

Walker ’s ability to break chunk plays makes the decision even more difficult. He produced four explosive runs in Week 1, including a 60-yard touchdown, and is averaging 6.2 yards per carry through two games.

Chiefs no longer relying on one source

Kansas City’s improvement goes beyond Walker . Kelce has already ripped off a 59-yard reception after topping out at 44 yards on a single catch last season.

Tyquan Thornton made two critical explosive catches against Indianapolis, including a 30-yard gain on third-and-12 in overtime that helped keep the Chiefs alive.

Rashee Rice also delivered four catches for 83 yards in that victory, averaging 20.8 yards per reception. That variety is what makes the offense particularly difficult to prepare for.

Mahomes can attack deep, Walker can control the ground game and Kansas City’s receivers are beginning to generate chunk yardage from several different spots.

Miami cannot afford to let Kansas City dictate game

The Dolphins ’ biggest challenge may be preventing the Chiefs from staying ahead of the chains.

Consistent early-down success would allow Kansas City to mix play-action, quick throws and explosive shots while keeping Miami’s pass rush from controlling the tempo.

Walker has effectively given Mahomes another answer before the ball is even snapped.

Kansas City travels to Hard Rock Stadium on September 27 for its first road game of the season, and Miami will have to solve more than the quarterback who has defined the Chiefs ’ offense for years.

The problem now is that the run game may be just as capable of forcing the defense to adjust.

articles.title: Travis Kelce praises Patrick Mahomes for the way he capitalized on the Colts' coin toss error
articles.standfirst: Mahomes was ready to pounce when the Colts captain appeared to misunderstand the overtime rules
articles.summary: Mahomes was ready to pounce when the Colts captain appeared to misunderstand the overtime rules
articles.body:
Travis Kelce has praised Patrick Mahomes for attempting to turn an unusual coin-toss mistake into a potential advantage during the Kansas City Chiefs’ overtime victory over the Indianapolis Colts.

The bizarre moment unfolded at Arrowhead Stadium after the teams finished regulation tied. Colts safety Camryn Bynum won the overtime coin toss, but instead of choosing to receive or kick, he said he wanted to “defer.”

While that decision is an option at the start of a regular game, it doesn’t apply in overtime because there’s no second half to defer a choice to. The confusion forced referee Craig Wrolstad to pause and clarify exactly what Bynum intended to do.

Mahomes quickly recognized an opportunity. According to Kelce , the Chiefs quarterback told the official that he wanted Kansas City to kick, effectively trying to take advantage of Bynum’s incorrect use of the term “defer.”

Mahomes apparently believed that if the Colts had declined to make a valid choice, the decision would move to Kansas City. He then indicated that the Chiefs wanted to kick and appeared determined to make sure the referee understood his position.

However, the officials didn’t simply accept Mahomes ’ attempt. Wrolstad continued speaking with Bynum and asked additional questions to establish what the Colts actually wanted. Bynum eventually made it clear that Indianapolis wanted to start on defense, meaning the Colts would kick off.

The Chiefs quarterback’s attempt therefore didn’t work, but Kelce was impressed by how quickly Mahomes identified the potential opening.

On the latest episode of New Heights, Kelce explained that Mahomes was completely focused on the situation. He also admitted that he wasn’t entirely familiar with the overtime coin-toss wording himself before his brother Jason Kelce clarified the rule.

“Pat was locked in. ... I don’t even know if defer is something you can say in that situation,” Kelce said.

Kelce explains Mahomes’ quick thinking

Jason Kelce also had plenty to say about the situation, arguing that players chosen as captains should know the coin-toss procedures before stepping into such an important moment. He pointed out that officials have increasingly needed to clarify these decisions because players sometimes use the wrong terminology.

Bynum’s error ultimately didn’t cost the Colts the game. Kansas City still received an opportunity in overtime and eventually won 33-30 when Harrison Butker connected on a 40-yard field goal as time expired.

Mahomes later explained his thinking, saying he believed Bynum’s use of “defer” meant the choice would effectively become Kansas City’s. His strategy wasn’t successful, but it demonstrated how closely he was monitoring every detail during a tense finish.

The episode provided another example of Mahomes ’ instinctive ability to react when an unexpected opportunity presents itself in Kelce’s eyes. The quarterback didn’t need the coin-toss advantage to help Kansas City secure the victory, but he was certainly prepared to capitalize if the rules had allowed it.

The victory moved the Chiefs to 2-0 and gave them an early boost after their 6-11 campaign last season. With Mahomes and Kelce still leading the offense, Kansas City has already shown signs of a different mindset this season, with Kelce previously pointing to improved unity and chemistry within the team.

articles.title: Taylor Swift's new single reveals intimate details about relationship with husband Travis Kelce
articles.standfirst: New song references Kelce’s hometown, their wedding and criticism surrounding their relationship
articles.summary: New song references Kelce’s hometown, their wedding and criticism surrounding their relationship
articles.body:
Taylor Swift has spent years turning the details of her personal life into music, but there is little ambiguity surrounding the inspiration for one of her newest songs.

“Cleveland!,” released Friday as part of The Life of a Showgirl: The Encore, is filled with references to husband Travis Kelce , from his childhood in Cleveland Heights, Ohio, to the couple’s wedding in New York City earlier this summer.

Swift even describes Kelce as the “love of my life,” making the song one of her clearest musical declarations about their relationship since the Kansas City Chiefs star first became part of her public story.

The title itself appears to reference Kelce ’s hometown, while the song also points toward Cleveland Heights and the house where he grew up. Another reference appears to play on New Heights, the podcast Kelce co-hosts with his older brother Jason.

Public criticism turned into part of song

The track doesn't simply celebrate the relationship. Swift also addresses the intense commentary that has followed the couple, including criticism of her personality, their age and whether their romance would last under the scrutiny surrounding two globally recognizable figures.

Rather than treating that attention as a source of uncertainty, the song frames Kelce as the person whose opinion ultimately matters. That theme reaches its clearest point when Swift calls him the “love of my life.”

The ending adds another apparent nod to their July 3 wedding at Madison Square Garden, with Swift singing, “Now I’m wearing white!” The couple married less than three months before the new material arrived.

Growing catalog of Kelce-inspired songs

Swift has previously been linked to Kelce through songs including “The Alchemy” and “So High School” on The Tortured Poets Department, before their relationship appeared to influence several tracks on The Life of a Showgirl.

Those included “Elizabeth Taylor,” “Opalite” and “Wood.” Swift later acknowledged during an appearance with Jimmy Fallon that “Wood” had evolved significantly from its original concept.

“I brought this into the studio and I was like I wanna do a throwback, kind of timeless-sounding song,” Swift said. “It really started out in a very innocent place… I don’t know what happened, man.”

Four new songs expand ‘The Life of a Showgirl’

“Cleveland!” arrives alongside three other new tracks: “Patient Zero,” “Pink Clouding” and “Babylon.”

Swift wrote and produced the material in Sweden with longtime collaborators Max Martin and Shellback , describing the songs as being created out of gratitude for the response to The Life of a Showgirl.

The release also comes shortly before Swift ’s appearance at the MTV Video Music Awards, where she is expected to debut the “Patient Zero” music video. Kelce , though, gets perhaps the most personal moment of the new collection.

Between Cleveland, his childhood home, their marriage and Swift ’s declaration of love, “Cleveland!” leaves considerably less room for fan detective work than many of her previous songs.

articles.title: Who was Lamar Hunt, Clark Hunt's father, and how did his legacy change Chiefs history?
articles.standfirst: The Chiefs founder helped create the AFL and moved the team to Kansas City
articles.summary: The Chiefs founder helped create the AFL and moved the team to Kansas City
articles.body:
Long before the Kansas City Chiefs became one of the NFL’s defining franchises, Lamar Hunt was trying to force his way into professional football.

Unable to secure an NFL franchise, Hunt helped establish the American Football League in 1959 and launched the Dallas Texans as one of its original teams. Four years later, he moved the franchise to Kansas City and renamed it the Chiefs .

The AFL-NFL merger in 1970 eventually transformed the sport, and Hunt ’s influence became permanent enough that the AFC Championship trophy now bears his name.

Clark Hunt , however, has often described a very different side of the man remembered as a football pioneer.

“My dad was a great father,” Clark said in a 2013 interview with the Chiefs.

Father led through example

Lamar ’s business reputation was built on bold decisions, but Clark remembers a leadership style that was much quieter.

“He was somebody who led by example,” Clark said. “More so than somebody who was prone to giving lectures, but it would be to treat others as you would want to be treated.”

That philosophy became especially important after Lamar died in December 2006 and Clark took on a larger leadership role with the organization.

Clark has said one of the clearest lessons involved the way Lamar thought about supporters.

“The fans were always his focus,” Clark said. He recalled his father repeatedly asking, “How’s this going to benefit our fans? How’s this going to make the experience at Arrowhead better on Sunday?”

Clark added: “Our fans are the lifeblood of the organization; that’s really a lesson that he taught me.”

Lamar Hunt’s sporting legacy

Kansas City remains the most visible expression of Hunt ’s influence, but his impact stretched well beyond the NFL.

He was also deeply involved in professional soccer in the United States and played a role in bringing the 1994 FIFA World Cup to the country.

That wider sporting vision helped establish Hunt as one of the most influential owners of his era, but Clark has repeatedly emphasized that his father’s legacy was never just about expansion, trophies or business success.

It was also about how people were treated and what kind of institution the family wanted to build.

Personal memories had little to do with football

One of Clark ’s favorite stories about his father involves the annual Turkey Trot in Dallas.

“It was something he and I started when I was about seven years old,” Clark said.

The tradition began after Clark suffered an injury and Lamar decided they would run an eight-mile race together despite neither being prepared for the distance.

“I can’t say I necessarily looked forward to it every year,” Clark said, “but it’s definitely a special memory of something he and I did.”

That story helps explain why Lamar Hunt ’s influence remains so central to Clark ’s stewardship of the Chiefs .

His father helped build a league, moved a franchise and changed the structure of professional football.

Clark ’s task has been different: preserve the values behind it while allowing the organization to evolve.

articles.title: Travis Kelce calls on the NFL to address dangerous field conditions after ‘Squirt Squad’ moment shocks him
articles.standfirst: Travis and Jason were surprised by how hot it was at the Titans' stadium last week
articles.summary: Travis and Jason were surprised by how hot it was at the Titans' stadium last week
articles.body:
With a 2-0 start and more than 30 points in both games, you can say the Kansas City Chiefs have already put last year’s slip behind them, that 6-11 mark that was the franchise’s worst since 2012 (2-14) and the worst of the Andy Reid era , only the second time in 13 seasons as head coach he missed the playoffs.

Bringing in Kenneth Walker III , the league’s leading rusher, and putting Eric Bieniemy back as offensive coordinator has been a big part of why this start looks different, and Patrick Mahomes and Travis Kelce look as sharp as they did in those early years together.

Best example was the 33-30 overtime win over the Indianapolis Colts , when Mahomes threw for 382 yards , his highest single-game passing total since 2023, and Kelce went for nine catches, 101 yards and a touchdown, his best game since 2024.

Travis Kelce Calls Out Extreme Heat on NFL Turf

Next up are the Miami Dolphins in one of the hottest buildings in the NFL, and the one break for Kansas City, especially for Kelce, is that Hard Rock Stadium is natural grass, not artificial turf.

That matters after the last episode of New Heights , when Kelce reacted to video of coaches spraying water straight onto players’ shoes to fight the heat. “The squirt squad was out there! What is this?” he said. “You shouldn’t be allowed to do that. You shouldn’t be allowed to put players on a field that does that. Why is that even allowed?”

That was after the turf at Nissan Stadium hit 157 degrees Fahrenheit during the game, up from 95 at kickoff, heat that reportedly melted the soles of cleats and forced emergency measures on the sideline.

“It’s so insane to me that you’re allowed to put the product in a situation like that. The NFL has got to figure something out for that. That’s insane.”

Nissan is one of 14 NFL venues still on artificial turf , and 16 of the league’s 32 teams play home games on synthetic surfaces, including outdoor stadiums used by the Patriots, Seahawks, Bengals, Giants and Jets.

NFLPA Keeps Pushing Grass After Injury Numbers

Kelce was not the only one. Eagles tackle Jordan Mailata , who has sat in those talks for the NFL Players Association , tied it back to the union’s long push for natural grass in every stadium.

The NFLPA has pointed to 2012-2018 data showing a 28% higher rate of non-contact lower-extremity injuries on turf than grass , including 32% more non-contact knee injuries and 69% more non-contact foot and ankle injuries.

The league’s answer is that overall injury rates look similar when you count every category, and they have used 2025 numbers of 0.43 injuries per game on turf versus 0.42 on grass .

That is the fight sitting in the background while the Chiefs fly to Miami 2-0, with Mahomes and Kelce rolling and a grass field waiting instead of another 157-degree track.

articles.summary: Erin Andrews’ latest gesture highlights her longstanding friendship with Brittany Mahomes
articles.body:

Andrews was quick to respond after seeing Brittany’s post. She reposted the Instagram story and added a series of heart emojis alongside “U!!”

Andrews launched WEAR with Constance Schwartz-Morini in 2019 after noticing a gap in the market for fashionable sports apparel aimed at women. The brand has since expanded across several major sports and leagues, including the NFL, MLB, NHL, NBA, WNBA, NCAA, WWE and U.S. Soccer.

Swift attended Kansas City’s Week 2 matchup against the Indianapolis Colts on September 20 and was spotted wearing a Chiefs tank from Andrews’ collection. Swift has worn WEAR apparel before, including during the 2025 Super Bowl, helping bring additional attention to Andrews ’ growing sports-fashion business.

articles.title: Chris Jones' lingering issue could hurt Patrick Mahomes' plans for Week 3
articles.standfirst: Kansas City could be without a key defensive presence as Chris Jones continues to deal with a calf issue
articles.summary: Kansas City could be without a key defensive presence as Chris Jones continues to deal with a calf issue
articles.body:
The Kansas City Chiefs enter their Week 3 meeting with the Miami Dolphins carrying a few injury concerns, with Chris Jones' continued limitations standing out as one of the biggest.

Kansas City is 2-0 and will look to maintain its perfect start in Miami, but the status of several defensive players could affect how the game unfolds.

Jones has been dealing with a calf injury since Week 1 and remained a limited participant in practice. The veteran defensive tackle also played through the problem last week, meaning his ability to handle a full workload on Sunday remains something to monitor.

His absence would create a significant challenge for Kansas City. Jones remains one of the most experienced and productive pieces of the Chiefs' defensive front, and losing him could put additional pressure on the rest of the unit.

While the latest reports haven't ruled him out, the recurring limitation suggests the team is still managing the injury carefully.

The Chiefs have encouraging developments elsewhere. Chamarri Conner has returned to limited work after missing time following a training camp collision, while rookie cornerback Mansoor Delane has progressed to full participation.

Jaden Hicks has also been heavily involved, giving Kansas City more options in a secondary that has dealt with injuries.

L'Jarius Sneed, meanwhile, remains limited because of his knee. Kansas City has continued to manage his practice workload, but he's been available on game day. Patrick Mahomes has also been able to practice fully, providing some positive news for the Chiefs' offense.

Chiefs balancing injuries with Walker's workload

Josh Simmons remains another concern. The left tackle has continued to miss practice because of his back injury and hasn't been able to reclaim his expected starting role. That leaves Kansas City relying on its replacement while Simmons ' return timetable remains uncertain.

The Chiefs are also planning to manage Kenneth Walker III's workload. Walker has been a major part of the team's 2-0 start, producing significant all-purpose yardage while handling a heavy number of touches.

Kansas City doesn't want to take him out of the offensive equation, but the coaching staff wants to give rookie Emmett Johnson more opportunities.

That approach could help preserve Walker's effectiveness as the season progresses while allowing Johnson to develop. The rookie has already shown enough to earn additional opportunities, giving the Chiefs another option for keeping their running game productive without relying exclusively on Walker .

The central concern for the Chiefs heading into Miami is whether Kansas City can keep its key players healthy. Jones ' calf remains the biggest defensive question, while Simmons ' absence continues to affect the offensive line.

With the Chiefs chasing a third straight victory, Sunday's matchup should provide another indication of how well they can manage those lingering issues.

articles.title: Shocking Kenneth Walker stat shows Chiefs got a steal in free agency that has transformed their offense
articles.standfirst: It’s no surprise that the Super Bowl MVP has gotten off to a hot start, but even the Chiefs couldn’t have expected this.
articles.summary: It’s no surprise that the Super Bowl MVP has gotten off to a hot start, but even the Chiefs couldn’t have expected this.
articles.body:
Through two weeks of the 2026 NFL season , it’s almost not being talked about enough that the Kansas City Chiefs look to have completely rebounded from a disastrous 2025. A drubbing of the Denver Broncos in Week 1 was followed by an overtime win over a resilient Indianapolis Colts team in Week 2.

Along the way, the Chiefs have racked up a strong 64 points through those two games, and a date against a bad Miami Dolphins defense is up next. Patrick Mahomes has looked like his usual self, which is the best news, but it’s been Kenneth Walker III who has stolen the headlines - and for good reason.

In just two games, Walker has already amassed 369 total yards and two touchdowns . He's already over a quarter of the way to his 2025 total ; meaning he's on pace to surpass his best-ever season in just eight games.

Kenneth Walker is avoiding tackles at a historic rate

What's even crazier is that Walker isn't doing this because of incredible blocking or the offense manufacturing touches in open space for him . Right now, Walker leads the league in avoided tackle percentage by an insane 19.3 percentage points over the second-best running back.

That number will surely go down as the season progresses, but it isn't a fluke by any means. In fact, Walker led the league in avoided tackle rate in 2025, too, at 34.4% .

The Chiefs, and Andy Reid in particular, have been fiending to find a running back like Walker for some time now. They finally got an elite one that is changing the Chiefs offense.

articles.title: Brittany Mahomes' tactic for "sidelining" other women who try to flirt with Patrick
articles.standfirst: Brittany and Patrick have dated since high school, but it hasn’t always been easy
articles.summary: Brittany and Patrick have dated since high school, but it hasn’t always been easy
articles.body:
As Patrick Mahomes saw his fame explode with the Kansas City Chiefs , everyone showed interest, including women looking to put his relationship with Brittany under pressure – a stress she eventually had to learn to tune out.

Their story began as teenage sweethearts in 2012, years before Patrick was winning NFL MVP s and leading the Chiefs to Super Bowls . Brittany knew him before the cameras, the headlines and the constant public scrutiny that now surround the quarterback.

It’s little surprise that the two married, having begun dating in high school, but as her husband’s success made him one of the biggest names in American sports, attention from other women became an unavoidable part of their public lives.

And Brittany addressed that challenge by admitting that she had not always found it easy to ignore women who pursued her man, revealing she used to get “extremely annoyed”.

“I did use to have a very hard time and get extremely annoyed,” Brittany said via Instagram. “But I am now to a point where I could care less. It’s actually really sad how disrespectful some women are, but they are a waste of my time and not going to disturb my peace.”

Rather than getting drawn into every interaction, Brittany explained that she had changed her approach and that has proven key as the Mahomes family has grown with three children, Sterling , Bronze and Golden .

And although it’s Patrick who wins all of the praise on the field, he does not forget his wife and has spoken about the qualities he appreciates in Brittany, particularly the confidence she brings to their family and her professional life.

“I admire my wife Brittany’s confidence,” Mahomes told People. “Whether it’s in business, or supporting our family, she always leads with strength and purpose. That kind of confidence is powerful; it pushes me to be better every day.”

Mahomes aims to shine against Miami Dolphins but isn't getting overconfident

That ability to block the outside noise has become relevant to Patrick and the Chiefs as they begin the 2026 NFL season, securing two wins with a 31-10 triumph over the Denver Broncos and a 33-30 overtime victory against the Indianapolis Colts .

Mahomes has looked increasingly comfortable following major knee surgery, throwing for 566 yards and five touchdowns across those two games. Yet the quarterback is refusing to let the team's fast start change its approach.

“In this league, it's week-to-week,” Mahomes said ahead of a clash with the Miami Dolphins . “One week they're patting you on the back, and one week they're telling you you're terrible.”

Kansas City endured a 6-11 campaign in 2025 and missed the NFL Playoffs for the first time since 2014, but the Chiefs have quickly gone from preseason skepticism to renewed praise, and the quarterback knows that perception can change just as quickly.

Mahomes threw for 382 yards and three touchdowns against Indianapolis , including a 22-yard completion to running back Kenneth Walker III during the decisive overtime drive before Harrison Butker kicked the winning field goal.

Walker has also given Kansas City another dimension, producing 290 rushing yards and a touchdown on 47 carries while adding 79 receiving yards and another score on nine receptions.

Mahomes understands that two wins do not equal a Super Bowl as Chiefs now turn their attention to the Dolphins in Week 3 , aiming to avoid an embarrassing moment against a team that has allowed 62 points in two games.

articles.title: Chiefs vs Dolphins: Where to watch Patrick Mahomes' game today and what time they play in Miami
articles.standfirst: Miami faces Mahomes’ machine this Sunday.
articles.summary: Miami faces Mahomes’ machine this Sunday.
articles.body:
The third week of the NFL season brings a matchup labeled a deadly trap for the home team. The Dolphins are seeking their first victory against the Chiefs , who want to remain undefeated in Week 3

The Miami Dolphins arrive reeling with an 0-2 record and with the worst point differential in the entire American Conference (-36), and they host the Kansas City Chiefs, who come in unstoppable , unbeaten at 2-0 and leading the AFC West division.

Where to watch Chiefs vs Dolphins today and what time does it start?

The clash between Miami and Kansas City takes place this Sunday, September 27, 2026 at Hard Rock Stadium in Miami Gardens . Kickoff is set for 1:00 p.m. Eastern Time (12:00 p.m. Central Time and 10:00 a.m. Pacific Time).

As for the live broadcast of the game, you can watch it live through the following platforms:

Streaming Service: Paramount+, NFL+ and YouTube TV

Overview of the day: two opposite trajectories

Nothing better sums up this game than the standings. Kansas City sits in first place in the AFC West and fourth overall in the league , with 64 points scored and 40 allowed after two weeks. Miami, meanwhile, is in last place in the AFC East and ranked 31st among the league’s 32 teams, with just 26 points scored and 62 allowed. The gap between them is not just in the standings: it is in the project.

The Chiefs opened the campaign with a convincing 31-10 win over the Denver Broncos at home and followed it up with an extremely tight 33-30 result against the Indianapolis Colts. Two victories, the second of them in a shootout that showed Kansas City's offense is still capable of topping 30 points even when the defense falters.

Miami, meanwhile, has not found its footing. It fell 27-13 on the road against the Las Vegas Raiders in Week 1 and was routed 35-13 in San Francisco by the 49ers in Week 2. Two road losses, both by wide margins, that leave the Florida team urgently needing to claim its first win of the year precisely against the least suitable opponent.

Chiefs vs Dolphins: experience versus desperation and recent results

Kansas City arrives not only with two wins in its pocket, but also with the backing of a previous high-flying campaign: in the 2025 playoffs it defeated the Houston Texans (23-14) in the Divisional Round and the Buffalo Bills (32-29) in the Conference Championship, before falling in the Super Bowl to the Philadelphia Eagles (40-22). It is a team seasoned in big moments, and that DNA shows in how it handles close games like the one in Indianapolis.

At the heart of that machine is quarterback Patrick Mahomes backed by a receiving corps led by Xavier Worthy and Rashee Rice , plus veteran tight end Travis Kelce, a historic piece of this franchise. In the backfield, Kenneth Walker III brings the ground game. It is a deep offensive arsenal that Miami will have to contain for 60 minutes.

On the home side, the Dolphins are placing their hopes in quarterback Malik Willis and in one of their most dangerous weapons, running back De"Von Achane, capable of breaking open a game with a single explosive play. Wide receiver Malik Washington and tight end Greg Dulcich round out a group of weapons that, however, has looked subdued at the start of the season.

Although we are only in the third week, the context already weighs heavily. Kansas City shares the AFC West lead with the Las Vegas Raiders ( both 2-0), so every win counts to avoid losing ground in a division expected to be tightly contested. A third straight victory would keep the Chiefs among the conference elite.

For Miami, the outlook is bleaker: they are the absolute basement of the AFC East, below the Buffalo Bills who are already 2-0. Another stumble would leave them at 0-3, a hole that very few teams manage to climb out of to contend for the playoffs. This game, more than about adding a win, is a matter of emotional survival.

What is the forecast for the Chiefs vs Dolphins?

The betting market is unequivocal: Kansas City enters as the overwhelming favorite, with an implied probability of 83.9% compared to Miami's slim 16.1%. The point spread has the Chiefs around -11, and the total points line is around 46.

The numbers and logic agree: an undefeated Chiefs team, with Super Bowl experience and a top-tier offense, should prevail over a winless Miami squad with the worst defense in its conference.

The only glimmer of hope for the home team is to make the most of their home field and force mistakes from an opponent that already showed defensive cracks in Indianapolis. The prediction clearly leans toward a Kansas City road win by a comfortable margin.

articles.title: Will Taylor Swift be at the Chiefs vs Dolphins? This is what we know about it
articles.standfirst: Kansas City takes on Miami on Sunday, September 27.
articles.summary: Kansas City takes on Miami on Sunday, September 27.
articles.body:
The Kansas City Chiefs ' trip to the Miami Dolphins comes with plenty of football storylines, but the biggest question away from the field may concern whether Taylor Swift will make an appearance at Hard Rock Stadium on Sunday, September 27. Swift has been present for both of Kansas City 's games this season, supporting Travis Kelce from the stands as the Chiefs opened the campaign with two victories, and her potential appearance in Miami has now become a talking point because the game falls on the same weekend as the MTV Video Music Awards .

Swift was also seen celebrating Kelce 's latest touchdown against the Indianapolis Colts , flashing her wedding ring after the tight end found the end zone as the tight end made nine catches for 101 yards. Patrick Mahomes has 566 passing yards and five touchdowns over the season. But the timing of Sunday's game and the MTV VMAs ceremony creates a significant logistical problem if she intends to attend both events as Kansas City and Miami are scheduled to kick off at 13:00 ET/10:00 PT, with the game expected to finish around 16:00 ET/13:00 PT. That leaves roughly three and a half hours between the expected conclusion of the Chiefs game and the start of the ceremony. According to American Airlines , a flight from Miami to Los Angeles takes around five hours and 45 minutes, making attendance at both events not realistic. Swift will have to attend the Chiefs game and skip the ceremony, or travel directly to Los Angeles without making an appearance at Hard Rock Stadium , and the former is more unlikely on this particular occasion.

Swift to be honored by VMAS

Swift ’s presence at Kansas City 's first two games also means a third consecutive appearance cannot be ruled out but there is an additional reason as to why her name has generated so much interest over the last week. The 36-year-old billionaire announced and released a new single named Patient Zero spontaneously, alongside the deluxe edition of The Life of a Showgirl: Encore Edition , which officially dropped on Friday, September 25. articles.title: Tyreek Hill's latest decision could change his future and bring him closer to the Chiefs for good: Is Mahomes already
articles.standfirst: Hill is still a free agent as he recovers from a nasty injury sustained in the 2025 NFL season
articles.summary: Hill is still a free agent as he recovers from a nasty injury sustained in the 2025 NFL season
articles.body:
T yreek Hill 's future remains one of the NFL 's biggest unanswered questions, but his latest move away from the football field has added another layer to the speculation surrounding his next destination.

The former Miami Dolphins star has relisted his sprawling Southwest Ranches, Florida , mansion for $7.7 million just one month after taking it off the market. Hill originally purchased the property for $6.9 million in 2022 after leaving the Kansas City Chiefs .

The timing has inevitably drawn attention, particularly with Hill currently a free agent and recovering from the knee dislocation and ACL tear he suffered in Week 4 last season. A potential return to Kansas City has already been discussed, and moving on from his Florida home gives those rumors another talking point.

The nine-bedroom, 9.5-bath property sits on more than two acres and includes a podcast studio, arcade, pool room, home gym, heated pool, spa, putting green, basketball court, summer kitchen, bar, two guesthouses and a four-car garage.

He first listed the mansion in March around the time the Dolphins released him, before removing the property from the market in August. He has now put it back up for sale at $7.7 million, according to Realtor.com.

The bigger question for Hill remains whether he can return to the explosive form that made him one of the league's most dangerous receivers as the 32-year-old suffered a significant knee injury, creating understandable questions about whether he would regain his famous speed.

His latest workout, however, has offered a more encouraging glimpse through a video shared on his Instagram shows the receiver performing agility drills on the beach, moving through the sand with the explosiveness that has long been central to his game.

It does not establish that Hill has been medically cleared, but it provides an encouraging sign during his rehabilitation and for Chiefs fans looking for an upgrade at wide receiver as Rashee Rice and Xavier Worthy continue to struggle to truly take off – although Tyquan Thornton has shown promise.

Chiefs defense aims for commanding performance vs Dolphins

On the other side of the football, Kansas City 's defense also enters a clash with the Dolphins looking to rebound after two very different performances after facing the Denver Broncos and Indianapolis Colts .

The Chiefs recorded four sacks and held Denver to 10 points in Week 1 but failed to sack Daniel Jones in the following week's 33-30 overtime win against Indianapolis .

And the lowly Miami could provide another opportunity to generate pressure as the Dolphins have allowed nine sacks through two games, while Malik Willis has faced pressure on 43.1% of his dropbacks.

Notably, the right side of Miami 's offensive line has struggled against rushers, creating opportunities for Kansas City 's George Karlaftis and R Mason Thomas, a second-round pick, to have a chance to make an impact.

Chris Jones is another player looking to get on the board after failing to record a sack through the opening two games, whilst only making seven sacks in the 2025 NFL season as the entire unit struggled, recording just 35 in total.

articles.summary: Patrick Mahomes was caught in an awkward moment as he stepped off the team bus at Hard Rock Stadium. What initially looked like a casual arrival may have had a little more intention behind it. Mahomes is an ambassador for Oakley, and the brand-sponsored video quickly went viral after the Chiefs quarterback made it pretty obvious that his sunglasses were meant to get some camera time too. As he made his way into the stadium, Mahomes suddenly froze for a few seconds in front of the cameras, awkwardly turning his head as if making sure the glasses got their moment in the spotlight. He seemed to be trying to make the pose look natural, but the stiff movement made it look anything but effortless. Still, Mahomes did his part — the sunglasses were clearly on display.

articles.title: Taylor Swift pulls back the curtain with her most Travis Kelce centric track yet
articles.standfirst: “Cleveland!” gives fans a rare look at Travis Kelce’s world and Swift’s life with him
articles.summary: “Cleveland!” gives fans a rare look at Travis Kelce’s world and Swift’s life with him
articles.body:
L iterally, Travis Kelce is the reason one of Taylor Swift’s new songs exists. “Cleveland!” has quickly become one of the tracks fans were waiting to hear, although reactions to the song have been divided.

The tribute to her husband is clear, not only because Kelce is featured throughout the video in previously unseen footage, but also because Swift uses the song to reference the place where he was born and raised. She sings about him taking her to Cleveland and showing her the Heights, an apparent reference to Cleveland Heights.

A very personal look at Kelce’s roots

The video adds another layer to the song, showing Kelce behind the wheel before Swift appears toward the end from the passenger seat . The footage offers an uncommon glimpse at the couple together, away from the usual public appearances and bigger moments surrounding their relationship.

At the same time , the song has drawn criticism from listeners who expected something different from Swift . “Cleveland!” is an upbeat, piano-driven pop track with a melody that has been compared to the opening notes of The Office theme. Over snare drum hits with a marching feel, Swift uses the song to push back against people who judge their relationship while making it clear how much she loves her husband.

Catchy, simple and very much about Travis

Some listeners have suggested that the song feels like something Swift could have written and released quickly, especially compared with some of her more elaborate romantic songs. Still, its simplicity may be part of its appea l. The track is catchy enough to stay in your head, with a melody that can have fans singing along without thinking twice.

What is clear is that the song works as a response to critics of their relationship while also giving fans a rare look at their dynamic as a married couple. Seeing the two of them together in Cleveland, seemingly without much fanfare, makes the footage feel different from the usual glimpses fans get of them.

Opinions will always be divided whenever Swift releases something new, but her fans continue to pay close attention when she puts her relationship with Kelce into her music . And with “Cleveland!”, she has given Swifties another song centered on how much her husband has changed her life.

articles.title: Patrick Mahomes' dominant Chiefs victory over Dolphins prompts ominous warning to the rest of the league
articles.standfirst: Patrick Mahomes has silenced every doubt after his ACL injury, leading the Chiefs to a perfect 3-0 start.
articles.summary: Patrick Mahomes has silenced every doubt after his ACL injury, leading the Chiefs to a perfect 3-0 start.
articles.body:
The Kansas City Chiefs have shown that their disappointing 2025 season is firmly in the rearview mirror, and much of that resurgence has a name and a face: Patrick Mahomes . The quarterback has regained the elite form that made him the face of the NFL before the serious knee injury he suffered last year.

Mahomes surprised the entire league by returning as the starter in the season opener against the Denver Broncos —exactly nine months after tearing his ACL against the Los Angeles Chargers last December .

With the Chiefs still undefeated at 3-0 after Sunday’s win over the Miami Dolphins, former All-Pro offensive lineman Kyle Long declared that Kansas City’s quarterback has reclaimed the throne as the best in the NFL.

“They’ve been talking about Kenneth Walker, they’ve been talking about Spags’ defense,” Long said on NFL Today on CBS. “I think about this guy right here, Patrick Mahomes. He spent every day of the winter, every day of the spring, every morning and day of the summer when everybody else was out playing golf and having fun, and he was getting his ass back in the lineup.

“Nothing happens without No. 15,” Long continued. “Week 1, what did we wanna see? We wanted to see if the knee was OK. Patrick ripped the Band-Aid off, dove headfirst down there at the goal line. He said, ‘Call off all the shots. All the doubters can take a nap.’ And this past week, what we saw from Patrick Mahomes was the greatest quarterback on our planet right now. And he’s back to being him. That’s what’s on my mind. The league is on notice.”

Mahomes leads Chiefs past Miami

Mahomes turned in another strong performance, completing 20 of 24 passes for 246 yards , two touchdowns, and one interception in Kansas City’s road victory over the Dolphins .

It marked the Chiefs’ first road game of the season after opening the year with home wins over the Denver Broncos and Indianapolis Colts at Arrowhead.

Through three games, Mahomes has thrown for 812 yards, seven touchdowns, and just two interceptions—numbers that underscore Kansas City’s excellent start.

Chiefs aim to stay perfect in Las Vegas

Next up, the Chiefs will try to complete a perfect first quarter of the season when they visit the Las Vegas Raider s in Week 4 .

The Raiders face the New Orleans Saints this Sunday. A win would leave them 3-0 and turn the matchup against Kansas City into a battle for sole possession of first place in the AFC West .

Kansas City had dominated that division for nine straight seasons before their unexpected 6-11 campaign in 2025 . Prior to that stumble, the Chiefs had reached seven consecutive AFC Championship Games, appeared in five Super Bowls, and won three titles.

Mahomes was the driving force behind that dynasty and already owns two MVP awards. If he sustains this level of play and the Chiefs keep winning, the quarterback could once again emerge as one of the leading candidates for a third career MVP .

articles.title: Travis Kelce's drastic transformation has fans in shock: “Did Kelce hop into a time machine and go back to 2022?"
articles.standfirst: Kelce scored his second touchdown of the NFL season against the Miami Dolphins.
articles.summary: Kelce scored his second touchdown of the NFL season against the Miami Dolphins.
articles.body:
After questions about whether Travis Kelce was past his prime, the veteran tight end delivered two game-changing plays as the Kansas City Chiefs moved to 3-0 with a 24-10 victory over the Miami Dolphins on Sunday.

Kelce has heard plenty of doubts since a disappointing 2026 NFL season raised questions about whether the Chiefs star was still capable of producing at the highest level after a relatively poor 2024 and 2025 by his standards.

But his latest performance offered a timely reminder of what he can still do as his team remained unbeaten thanks to the tight end’s late touchdown at the Hard Rock Stadium on September 27.

Although the 36-year-old was not heavily involved statistically as he finished with only two receptions for 59 yards, but both catches had a major impact on the game and the first came on Kansas City 's opening play.

Patrick Mahomes connected with Kelce , who turned the short opportunity into a spectacular 48-yard gain. The play immediately caught the attention of fans watching the veteran tight end look more like his dominant former self.

One fan on X wrote, “Did Kelce hop into a time machine and go back to 2022?”

Another praised the long-standing connection between the two Chiefs stars, writing, “Kelce and Mahomes' chemistry on plays out of structure is unmatched.”

A third fan was simply left amazed by Kelce's ability to create separation, asking, “I'm in awe man, how is he ALWAYS open???”

Chiefs pull through surprisingly competitive Dolphins game

Kansas City ultimately needed more than Kelce 's opening burst to secure its third consecutive victory. Mahomes finished with 246 passing yards and two touchdowns. Kenneth Walker III contributed a touchdown reception and a rushing score.

The Chiefs appeared ready to pull away after scoring touchdowns on their first two possessions, but Miami 's defense settled down and the rookie linebacker Jacob Rodriguez even intercepted Mahomes before halftime as Rashee Rice spilled a catch.

The Dolphins narrowed the deficit to 14-10 during the third quarter before Kelce then delivered again when Kansas City needed to create some breathing room after the Chiefs stopped their rivals on fourth down at the Dolphins ' 48-yard line.

Mahomes then found Taylor Swift ’s husband for an 11-yard touchdown with 2:55 remaining and the score put Kansas City ahead by two possessions and effectively ended Miami 's hopes of completing a comeback.

Elsewhere Rice led Kansas City with seven receptions for 88 yards, including catches of 15 and 34 yards on the Chiefs ' final scoring drive whilst Walker added 70 rushing yards on 18 carries on a tough day for the team.

The Dolphins fell to 0-3 after quarterback Malik Willis threw for 210 yards with an interception and lost fumble. Miami also lost De'Von Achane to a knee injury on its opening possession.

Kansas City now turns its attention to an AFC West showdown with the Las Vegas Raiders on October 4 but after three games, however, Kelce has already provided a reminder that his value cannot always be measured by volume.

articles.title: Brittany Mahomes' four-word reaction to one of the photos Patrick posted after the 3-0
articles.standfirst: Mahomes celebrated Kansas City's third consecutive win with two images on Instagram. Brittany chose one of them and left a special message.
articles.summary: Mahomes celebrated Kansas City's third consecutive win with two images on Instagram. Brittany chose one of them and left a special message.
articles.body:
The Kansas City Chiefs defeated the Miami Dolphins 24-10 at the Hard Rock Stadium and improved to 3-0 after three weeks of the 2026 NFL season. Patrick Mahomes completed 20 of 24 passes for 246 yards, threw two touchdowns, and was intercepted once.

After the game, the quarterback shared two photographs on Instagram with the message “3-0.” Brittany Mahomes commented on the second image: “The second pic IS 🔥🔥🔥🔥” (“ The second photo IS 🔥🔥🔥🔥”), the player’s wife wrote.

Mahomes acknowledges that the Chiefs still have room for improvement

Kansas City entered the fourth quarter with a 14-10 lead. Harrison Butker extended the gap with a field goal, and Mahomes later connected with Travis Kelce for an 11-yard touchdown with 2:55 remaining.

Kenneth Walker III opened the scoring with a 10-yard run and later caught a five-yard pass from Mahomes for his second score. He finished the game with 70 rushing yards and two touchdowns.

Mahomes acknowledged that the offense did not maintain the same level throughout the game . “Obviously, we did not play to the level we demand of ourselves” , he explained after the game when referring to what happened during much of the second and third quarter.

Brittany had shared images from Miami before kickoff. From the stands at Hard Rock Stadium, she showed the Kansas City fans who traveled to accompany the team and wrote: “Man, do I love #ChiefsKingdom show up always!!”. She also posted an image of Golden Raye, the couple’s youngest daughter, dressed in Chiefs colors and with “Mahomes 15” embroidered on her clothing.

With the victory over Miami, Kansas City improved to 3-0. The Chiefs began the season with a 31-10 win over Denver, then defeated Indianapolis 33-30 in overtime and closed out the first three weeks with the victory over the Dolphins. Mahomes has totaled 812 passing yards and seven touchdowns in those three games, along with two interceptions.

Kansas City will play on the road again in Week 4. The Chiefs will visit the Las Vegas Raiders on Sunday, October 4 at Allegiant Stadium.

articles.title: Patrick Mahomes' physical condition takes a major hit amid yet another refereeing controversy involving the Chiefs
articles.standfirst: Did the referees favor Kansas City against the Miami Dolphins?
articles.summary: Did the referees favor Kansas City against the Miami Dolphins?
articles.body:
The Kansas City Chiefs found themselves at the center of another officiating debate Sunday after a roughing-the-passer call involving Patrick Mahomes helped extend a drive against the Miami Dolphins . With less than three minutes remaining in the third quarter and Kansas City backed up near its own goal line, the quarterback dropped back looking for Rashee Rice but not before Chop Robinson closed in, making contact with his chest and shoulder as the he released the pass.

Mahomes went to the ground, but the ball fell incomplete. Officials immediately threw a flag, ruling that Robinson had committed roughing the passer by landing on the QB with his body weight. The call sparked an immediate debate over where the NFL 's protection of quarterbacks crosses into protecting them from otherwise legitimate tackles. Robinson did not appear to make contact with Mahomes ' head or neck and landed with his hands and arms helping absorb his weight. Kansas City faced third-and-9 from its own 5-yard line when the penalty was called. The 15-yard personal foul produced an automatic first down and kept the possession alive, eventually allowing Harrison Butker to kick a 34-yard field goal as the Chiefs built a 17-10 lead. Mahomes , however, did not appear particularly concerned about the hit after the game. “No, he got me. He got me pretty good. They brought a good stunt with the D-line, and I tried to get the ball out of my hand,” Mahomes said after the game, taking the hit in good spirits. “When you throw the ball, you’re kind of exposed, and he got me pretty solid. "But I was able to bounce back up there, and we went out there and finished that drive.”

What are the NFL rules on late hits and roughing the passer?

Late hits generally fall under unnecessary roughness. Defenders can be penalized for forcibly contacting a runner who is already out of bounds, continuing a hit after forward progress has ended or unnecessarily launching themselves into a player who is no longer involved in the action. But roughing the passer is a separate personal foul. It is designed to protect a quarterback during and immediately following a pass thrown from behind the line of scrimmage, whether that pass ultimately proves legal or illegal. Defenders must avoid prohibited contact with vulnerable areas of the quarterback and cannot unnecessarily drive the passer into the ground. Forceful contact involving the head or neck is also restricted. A roughing-the-passer penalty carries 15 yards and an automatic first down. Players can also face fines after games for violations covered by the league's disciplinary system. That issue has produced controversial calls involving Kansas City before. For example, Chris Jones roughing-the-passer penalty against the Las Vegas Raiders became one of the most debated officiating decisions of the 2022 season. During Kansas City 's 30-29 comeback victory, Jones appeared to make a game-changing play late in the second quarter as he strip-sacked Derek Carr , forced a fumble and recovered the ball. But the play was overturned by a roughing-the-passer penalty after referee Carl Cheffers ruled that Jones had landed on Carr with his full body weight. Rather than taking possession, the Chiefs gave Las Vegas an automatic first down, and the Raiders eventually kicked a field goal to take a 20-7 lead.

articles.title: Patrick Mahomes fails to pull off a smooth pose as his attempt turns awkward
articles.standfirst: Mahomes had the game-day look down, but his sunglasses moment was anything but smooth
articles.summary: Mahomes had the game-day look down, but his sunglasses moment was anything but smooth
articles.body:
B efore every game, Patrick Mahomes walks into the stadium fully locked in, usually wearing his headphones and sunglasses . It is part of his classic game-day look and a sign that he is ready for what is coming next. But this time, his usual entrance appeared to come with something else on his mind.

Nothing has been confirmed, but the way Mahomes walked and posed in front of the cameras made it look like he had a brand commitment to take care of before stepping onto the field. There were also two details that helped fuel that idea.

The sunglasses had their own moment

Mahomes is known as an ambassador for Oakley, and the brand's sunglasses have become a regular part of his pregame look. He wears them when arriving at stadiums and even during warmups, making them one of the accessories that rarely leave his game-day routine.

So, as Mahomes made his entrance at Hard Rock Stadium, it appeared he wanted to make sure the glasses got some serious camera time . The problem was that his attempt to make the moment look smooth quickly turned awkward.

A pose that looked better in a photo

Mahomes suddenly stopped for a few seconds in front of the cameras and turned his head in an uncomfortable-looking motion , seemingly making sure the sunglasses were clearly visible. He appeared to be trying to keep the pose natural, but the stiff movement made it look like he was walking with his neck slightly crooked.

The photo may have come out just fine, but t he moment looked noticeably more awkward on video.

Another sign that the sunglasses were supposed to be the focus came from the video itself. The Chiefs posted the clip, but t he watermark belonged to the eyewear brand , adding to the idea that Mahomes had a brand commitment to fulfill before making his way inside.

Mahomes may have had an awkward moment at the start of game day, but things went much better once the game began. The QB1 threw for 246 yards and two touchdowns, finishing with an 83.3% completion rate helping the Chiefs open their season with a 3-0 record.

articles.title: Patrick Mahomes and the Chiefs are 3-0 again putting Kansas City on a familiar path with Super Bowl implications
articles.standfirst: This is the fifth time in Mahomes’ nine seasons as starting quarterback that the Chiefs have started the season 3-0
articles.summary: This is the fifth time in Mahomes’ nine seasons as starting quarterback that the Chiefs have started the season 3-0
articles.body:
Pending the Monday Night Football clash between the Philadelphia Eagles (2-0) and the Caleb Williams-less Chicago Bears (1-1), the 2026 NFL season features five squads boasting unblemished 3-0 records.

Over in the NFC, the surging Minnesota Vikings , who recently traded their 2024 first-round pick J.J. McCarthy to the New York Giants , join the San Francisco 49ers , who look arguably like the most complete team across the league thus far.

Across the AFC , while powerhouse presences like the Buffalo Bills and the Kansas City Chiefs starting strong comes as no surprise, the Las Vegas Raiders have emerged as the surprise story of the conference.

Powered by surprisive elite defense and veteran quarterback Kirk Cousins , who has tossed three touchdown passes in every single game, the Raiders have delayed the debut of top overall draft pick Fernando Mendoza indefinitely.

Next up, Las Vegas faces its toughest test yet by welcoming Patrick Mahomes and the Chiefs to town for a historic showdown marking the first time both teams have ever met with matching 3-0 records .

Kansas City Chiefs Cruise to Fifth 3-0 Start of the Patrick Mahomes Era

Leaving last year's frustrations firmly in the rearview mirror, the Chiefs have established themselves as a juggernaut by ranking among the top five teams in total yards per game on offense while simultaneously sitting in the top five in fewest yards allowed per game on defense , making them the only franchise in football currently anchoring top-five status on both sides of the ball.

This blistering 3-0 start represents the fifth time Kansas City has opened a campaign with three straight victories since Patrick Mahomes assumed the starting role in 2018 .

Historical precedent favors a deep postseason run when the Chiefs hit this mark, as three of their previous 3-0 starts ( 2019, 2020, and 2024 ) culminated in Super Bowl appearances , resulting in a Lombardi Trophy during the 2019 campaign, the first of three titles secured in the Mahomes era.

With a balanced roster featuring superstar running back Kenneth Walker III, granting Mahomes the elite ground presence he has lacked for much of his Hall of Fame career, Kansas City firmly looks like the team to beat in the AFC .

Following their upcoming Week 4 divisional battle against the Raiders, the Chiefs will enjoy a well-timed early bye week to rest and recharge.

Even so, their remaining schedule stays tough, with away games against Denver, Seattle, Buffalo, Cincinnati, and the Los Angeles Rams.

articles.title: Maxx Crosby threatens Patrick Mahomes' confidence: The message that has the Chiefs trembling
articles.standfirst: Mahomes and the Chiefs are next on Crosby’s hit list
articles.summary: Mahomes and the Chiefs are next on Crosby’s hit list
articles.body:
Maxx Crosby wasn’t interested in letting the Las Vegas Raiders spend too much time celebrating their latest victory.

After Las Vegas defeated the New Orleans Saints 35-27 to move to 3-0, Crosby delivered an emphatic locker-room message. The star defensive end reminded his teammates that their attention now had to turn toward the Kansas City Chiefs, who’ll visit Allegiant Stadium in Week 4.

“It’s a great f****** win, but we got a great f****** team coming into town. We already know what the f***, we already know what it is, bro, it’s the f****** Kansas City Chiefs,” Crosby said.

“Enjoy this s*** tonight. Take care of your bodies and we’re f****** on a war path to get what we want, man. Love y’all boys. Let’s get it! Gang on me! Gang on three! 1 2 3, gang!”

The Raiders haven’t opened a season 3-0 since 2021, making their start particularly significant. However, Crosby knows an unbeaten record through three games won’t mean much if Las Vegas can’t maintain its intensity against one of its biggest AFC West rivals.

His comments, shared by The Rush with Maxx Crosby on September 28, immediately put the upcoming matchup at the center of attention.

The defensive star also knows exactly what it takes to face Patrick Mahomes . Crosby has previously spoken about the respect he has for Mahomes and Chiefs coach Andy Reid away from football, but he’s equally clear that those relationships change once the two teams step onto the field.

The respect doesn’t disappear on game day for Crosby . He’s described playing against Mahomes as going to war, while Mahomes has previously praised Crosby as one of the toughest pass rushers he’s faced.

Mahomes has a new weapon heading into Vegas

Kansas City will arrive in Las Vegas at 3-0 as well, following a 24-10 victory over the Miami Dolphins. Mahomes enters the matchup with plenty of confidence in an offense that’s beginning to look considerably different from last season.

The biggest change has been the impact of running back Kenneth Walker III . His presence has helped Kansas City establish a stronger ground threat, creating additional opportunities for Mahomes through play-action.

Against Miami, Mahomes completed all 14 of his play-action attempts for 201 yards and a touchdown, tying Russell Wilson’s mark from 2020 for the most completions without an incompletion on play-action over the past 20 seasons, according to ESPN Research.

Mahomes also finished the game 20-of-24 for 246 yards and two touchdowns, while Walker’s effectiveness continued to influence how opposing defenses approach Kansas City.

That could make Crosby’s challenge even tougher. The Raiders defensive leader won’t simply have to deal with Mahomes ’ ability to extend plays and attack downfield. Kansas City’s improved rushing threat can force defenders to hesitate, potentially creating openings for Travis Kelce and the Chiefs’ other pass catchers.

The Raiders, though, have plenty of momentum of their own. They’re unbeaten, they’re playing with confidence, and Crosby has already made it clear that the team isn’t satisfied with simply reaching 3-0.

The matchup also offers a fascinating contrast. Kansas City’s offense appears to be finding rhythm through a more balanced approach, while Crosby will look to disrupt Mahomes and prevent the quarterback from controlling the game.

Crosby’s fiery locker-room speech has set the tone. Now, the Raiders have to back it up on the field.

articles.title: Patrick Mahomes first 150 NFL games mirror Tom Brady’s in many remarkable ways
articles.standfirst: Both Mahomes and Brady have the same number of wins and Super Bowl rings after their first 150 games
articles.summary: Both Mahomes and Brady have the same number of wins and Super Bowl rings after their first 150 games
articles.body:
After Sunday's Week 3 slate, only five teams remain undefeated across the NFL : the Kansas City Chiefs , Las Vegas Raiders , Buffalo Bills , Minnesota Vikings , and San Francisco 49ers , with the Philadelphia Eagles holding a chance to join them on Monday night.

For the Chiefs, this unblemished 3-0 start marks the fifth time Kansas City has opened a campaign with three straight victories since Patrick Mahomes assumed the starting role in 2018.

Historically, a 3-0 start bodes exceptionally well for the franchise , as three of their previous trios of opening wins ( 2019, 2020, and 2024 ) culminated in Super Bowl appearances , resulting in a Lombardi Trophy during the 2019 season as the first of three titles captured in the Mahomes era.

Patrick Mahomes Matches Tom Brady in Historic Milestone Through 150 Games

Including postseason action, the recent victory over Miami marked a monumental milestone for Patrick Mahomes : his 150th career game , resulting in his 115th victory and tying Tom Brady for the most wins by any quarterback through their first 150 games in NFL history.

Comparing their historic trajectories through that exact milestone reveals fascinating parallels, as both legends captured three Super Bowl wins and two Super Bowl losses in their opening 150 contests, with one of Mahomes' losses coming directly against Brady.

Both quarterbacks also reached seven AFC title games boasting identical 5-2 records at that juncture, though Mahomes holds a slight edge with three Super Bowl MVP awards compared to Brady's two.

The starkest statistical differences lie in their aerial output: through 150 games, Brady threw 263 passing touchdowns against 118 interceptions , whereas Mahomes has accumulated an astonishing 320 touchdown passes against just 97 picks , alongside holding two regular-season MVP awards to Brady's one at the exact same career benchmark.

Chasing All-Time Regular Season Wins and the GOAT Status

Focusing solely on regular-season play, Mahomes' latest triumph marked his 98th victory , surpassing Tom Brady's 97 wins for the most by a quarterback through their first 10 seasons .

Ahead of him on that specific leaderboard stand only Russell Wilson (104) and Peyton Manning (105) . The crucial distinction is that while Mahomes is indeed playing his 10th NFL season, he is only in his ninth year as a full-time starter (having spent his rookie year learning behind Alex Smith).

While Tom Brady remains the undisputed GOAT of the sport, Mahomes' striking statistical similarities and superior early-career numbers make him the premier candidate to eventually challenge that throne.

articles.title: Taylor Swift and Madonna's extravagant demands during the MTV VMAs revealed
articles.standfirst: Madonna's photo rules and Taylor's brief VMA appearances revealed
articles.summary: Madonna's photo rules and Taylor's brief VMA appearances revealed
articles.body:
Taylor Swift and Madonna dominated the 2026 MTV Video Music Awards, but their influence reportedly extended well beyond the stage, with organizers accommodating a number of backstage preferences.

Madonna , 68, returned to the VMAs for the first time in 23 years and opened the ceremony alongside Sabrina Carpenter and Charli XCX . The pop icon went on to collect seven awards, including Artist of the Year and Best Collaboration with Carpenter for “Bring Your Love.”

Her return was accompanied by strict arrangements concerning her public appearances. According to reports, Madonna declined to pose on the red carpet and wanted only approved photographers to capture images of her performance.

articles.title: Brittany Mahomes' new tattoo connecting her to Patrick Mahomes forever: “People are so intrigued”
articles.standfirst: Fans had only seen glimpses of the design before
articles.summary: Fans had only seen glimpses of the design before
articles.body:
Brittany Mahomes has finally put an end to the curiosity surrounding the tattoo fans had been spotting on her arm.

After the design drew attention during the Kansas City Chiefs game on September 27, Mahomes shared a close-up on her Instagram Story two days later, revealing that the artwork is a tribute to the family she has built with quarterback Patrick Mahomes .

“I guess I never have shown my tattoo and people are so intrigued,” she wrote.

The tattoo features the names of the couple’s three children — Sterling, Bronze and Golden — along with their birthdays. Their side profiles are incorporated into the fine-line design, which runs delicately along her arm rather than using bold or heavily shaded imagery.

Patrick Mahomes also woven into the tattoo

The most personal detail is easy to miss at first glance. Brittany explained that Patrick ’s initials are integrated into the design alongside the children’s names and birthdays, turning the piece into a tribute to the entire family.

“It’s the side profiles of my kiddos with Patrick’s initials into their names and birthdays,” she wrote.

The tattoo’s style is deliberately understated. Thin black lines form the profiles, while the script follows the shape of her arm, giving the design a continuous look that ties each family member together.

Fans had previously only seen parts of the tattoo when Mahomes rolled up the sleeves of her white jacket while attending the Chiefs game. The later close-up offered the clearest look yet at how much meaning had been packed into a relatively simple design.

Mahomes also has another sentimental tattoo on her left wrist, where a paw print honors the family’s dogs, Steel and Silver.

Design reflects relationship that started in high school

Brittany and Patrick ’s story began long before the Super Bowls, endorsement deals and NFL spotlight. The pair started dating in high school in 2012, and Patrick later proposed in 2020 at Arrowhead Stadium.

Their first child, Sterling , was born in February 2021, before the couple married in Maui in March 2022. Their son, Bronze , followed in 2022, while daughter Golden arrived in January 2025, making the Mahomes family five.

That history gives the tattoo more meaning than a collection of names and dates. Each element traces a different part of the family’s story, from the children’s profiles to Patrick ’s initials, while the flowing design visually connects them all.

Brittany finally explained the detail fans had been trying to figure out. What first appeared to be a delicate piece of body art is, in reality, a compact family portrait.
